The book examines various geological eras, providing insights into the Earth's history as recorded in the rock formations of these iconic landscapes. The book covers topics ranging from the Archean and Algonkian eras, showcasing some of the oldest rocks known, to the more recent Cenozoic era, where it discusses the formation of natural features and the influences of various climatic conditions.
